    """Independent re-implementation of the documented topology grammar."""
    if not isinstance(spec, list) or len(spec) > 8 or not spec or not isinstance(spec[0], str):
        raise Invalid('topology shape')
    mode = spec[0]
    if mode == 'clos':
        check(len(spec) == 4)
        k = I(spec[1], 4, 18)
        check(k % 2 == 0)
        check(spec[2] in ('tor', 'pod'))
        intra = I(spec[3], 0, 1)
        n = k * k
        r = k // 2
        t = k * r
        templates = t * (t - 1 if intra else t - r)
    elif mode == 'leaf-spine':
        check(len(spec) == 3)
        leaves = I(spec[1], 2, 256)
        spines = I(spec[2], 1, 256)
        n = leaves + spines
        templates = leaves * (leaves - 1)
    elif mode in ('torus2d', 'torus3d'):
        check(len(spec) == 3)
        side = I(spec[1], 3, 18)
        other = 'row' if mode == 'torus2d' else 'line'
        check(spec[2] in ('host', other))
        n = side ** (2 if mode == 'torus2d' else 3)
        templates = n * (n - 1)
    elif mode == 'dragonfly':
        check(len(spec) == 5)
        g = I(spec[1], 1, 64)
        a = I(spec[2], 1, 64)
        h = I(spec[3], 1, 64)
        check(g >= 2 and g - 1 == a * h)
        check(spec[4] in ('router', 'group', 'target'))
        n = g * a
        templates = n * (n - 1)
    elif mode == 'dragonfly-plus':
        check(len(spec) == 7)
        g = I(spec[1], 1, 64)
        l = I(spec[2], 1, 64)

        check(spec[6] in ('tor', 'group'))
        n = g * (l + s)
        templates = (g * l) * (g * l - 1)
    else:
        raise Invalid('topology mode')
    check(n <= 343)
    return mode, n, templates

def validate(request):''')
